## Categories

- [Agency Finance & Margin Ops](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/categories/agency-finance-pricing/) (6 tools): Pricing calculators, retainer profitability trackers, multi-currency cashflow & invoicing toolkits for agencies and consultants.
- [EU Compliance & AI Governance](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/categories/eu-compliance-governance/) (8 tools): Checklists, policy playbooks and audit readiness tooling for EU AI Act, NIS2, DORA, GPSR and EUDR.
- [E-Invoicing & Audit Automation](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/categories/einvoicing-tax-audit/) (9 tools): XRechnung/ZUGFeRD validation, automated pre-accounting, receipt extraction and FinOps waste audits.
- [B2B Workflow & Lead Ops](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/categories/workflow-lead-ops/) (4 tools): Zero-bloat intake pipelines, RFP/tender response engines, enrichment APIs and static-first micro-tools.

- [Issue #003: Sovereign DACH Ops Stack — XRechnung AP Automation, BSI C5 Collaboration & AI Act Governance](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/briefing/issue-003-german-hosted-ops-gdpr-ap-automation/) (2026-11-23): Why German and EU mid-market buyers increasingly consolidate around sovereign DACH tools with native XRechnung 3.0, BSI C5 encryption, and unified NIS2/AI Act audit trails.
- [Issue #002: E-Rechnung 2027/2028 & EU AI Act Deployer Readiness — The DACH B2B Buyer Shortlist](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/briefing/issue-002-erechnung-2027-ai-act-deployer-checklist/) (2026-11-23): Mandatory XRechnung/ZUGFeRD issuance thresholds hit 800,000 EUR turnover companies on Jan 1, 2027, while EU AI Act governance rules tighten vendor audits across DACH SMEs.
- [Issue #001: Why Static Calculators & Verified Checklists Outconvert SaaS Bloat in 2026](https://cheresonanz-design.github.io/opskanon-directory/briefing/issue-001-zero-bloat-b2b-ops-stack/) (2026-11-22): How boutique agencies and DACH SMEs cut margin leakage by 15-30% using zero-macro spreadsheets, deterministic validation, and self-serve Stripe workflows.
